paragraphs: A Salmonella outbreak linked to raw oysters remains active across 13 states, with 28 cases and 5 hospitalizations reported as of October 30 [1]. Consumers should be cautious when consuming raw oysters [1]. The Salmonella Bovismorbificans outbreak linked to broccoli sprouts is now over, according to the CDC and FDA [2][10]. That outbreak affected 34 people across 6 states with 3 hospitalizations [2].

Once Upon a Farm is recalling all lots and varieties of Tractor Wheel Organic Toddler Soft-Baked bars because the snack can rapidly form a dense, sticky mass when chewed, posing a choking hazard [5]. Snack Right Super Foods (Brad's Raw Chips) is recalling Brad's Plant Based Crunchy Kale and Brad's Veggie Chips Kale products due to potential thallium contamination [3]. Vitality Works Inc. is recalling one lot (2025-26227) of 365 Whole Foods Market Standardized + Full Spectrum Blend Ashwagandha Capsules due to potential Salmonella contamination [7]. SLR Food Distribution Inc. is recalling Wise Wife Brand Ground Cinnamon because of elevated lead levels [8].
The FDA has expanded its alert on cinnamon products with dangerously high lead levels to include 21 products total [13].
